edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff, within five business days after execution of this Agreement by both parties.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the matters described in the Recitals. This release does not extend to any right to enforce this Agreement.

drafter.private_reasoning: Propose USD 32,500,000 as the opening settlement demand, preserving negotiating room. Accept reasonable late-payment remedies and targeted confidentiality exceptions while retaining the cleared-funds payment requirement and conditional release. All proposed terms remain subject to client approval and execution.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Subject to client approval and execution of a definitive agreement, our client proposes USD 32,500,000 to settle the claims. We have retained payment within five business days of execution and the release conditional on receipt of cleared funds. The revised draft includes default interest at 5% per annum, capped at the maximum lawful rate, and reasonable, documented enforcement costs following a payment default. We have also included confidentiality exceptions for legal and tax advisers, legally required disclosures, and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce the agreement. Please confirm whether your client can proceed on this basis or provide its monetary counterproposal.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 32,500,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff, within five business days after execution of this Agreement by both parties. Any portion of the Settlement Amount not paid when due shall bear simple interest from the due date until receipt in cleared funds at 5% per annum or the maximum lawful rate, whichever is lower. Following a payment default, Defendant shall also reimburse Plaintiff for reasonable, documented costs, including reasonable attorneys’ fees, actually incurred in enforcing the payment obligations under this Agreement.
edits.name: Payment and default remedies

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that a party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers who need to know them and are subject to professional or contractual confidentiality obligations; as required by law, regulation, or court order; or to the extent reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Disclosures under these exceptions shall be limited to what is reasonably necessary for the applicable purpose. To the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, a party required to make a disclosure by law, regulation, or court order shall give the other party advance written notice and a reasonable opportunity to seek confidential treatment.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions
